title: دنیای بصری نسخه‌ی وب مازستا — دست دوم
question: قرعه‌ی دوم، دنیای «پوستر مدرنیست تهران» را انتخاب کرد. همین را نگه دارید، یک جایگزین بردارید، یا دوباره قرعه بکشید.

options.label: Tehran Modernist Grid
options.lineage: Iranian modernist posters of the Momayez era and the Swiss typographic grid they shared
options.thesis: The machine's state set as a poster on a strict grid: huge bold numerals, yellow and black planes, every rule and column meaning something.
materials: heavy grotesk and bold Persian type
options.viewport: Dashboard as one poster: a yellow plane holding the machine's verdict, CPU/GPU temperatures as giant numerals on the grid, parts in ruled columns, navigation as a numbered index on the right edge.
options.risk: If the type is set timidly it becomes a plain dark dashboard; the numerals must be poster-scale.

raised.raise: The test queue is a numbered step column in the margin, each step carrying its state.
Type alone carries hierarchy: no cards, no shadows, no icons doing the work of size and weight.
State colours are laws: green only for passed, red only for failed, hatching only for not measured.
Component pages give one part the whole viewport, the next part one snap away.

options.label: Datasheet
options.lineage: semiconductor datasheets: electrical-characteristics tables, pinouts, block diagrams
options.thesis: Every page reads like the part's datasheet: numbered sections, min/typ/max tables, a block diagram of the machine.
options.viewport: Section 1 'Overview' with a block diagram of this PC, key figures in a characteristics table.
options.risk: Familiar and sober: the look many technical tools already borrow.

options.label: Warm Consumer Surface
options.thesis: Soft cards, plain labels, one saturated colour only on what can be pressed.
options.viewport: A single column of friendly cards with a bottom bar.
options.case: Wins on clarity (yellow means 'press'); loses on audience, a workshop tool is not a lifestyle app.
options.risk: Too soft for a stress-test bench.

options.label: Phosphor Terminal
options.thesis: The app as one live transcript; states print themselves.
options.viewport: A scrolling log with the live readings as the current line.
options.case: Technicians live in consoles (SFC, DISM), so it holds audience; loses clarity for charts and reports.
options.risk: Everything that is not text feels foreign.

options.label: Orizuru Sequence
options.thesis: One sheet folded in numbered steps.
options.viewport: A crease pattern beside the folded form.
options.case: Loses both: unrelated to the shop.
options.kept: Numbered steps in a margin column.

options.label: Vertical Feed
options.case: Loses both: a desktop workbench tool.
options.kept: One part per viewport on component pages.

options.label: Arcade Cabinet
options.case: Loses both: a toy costume on measurements.

canonCard.label: The category standard
canonCard.thesis: A dark hardware-monitor dashboard with cards, gauges and a sidebar, executed with care.
canonCard.viewport: Sidebar on the right, a grid of part cards with sparklines, the brand yellow as accent.
canonCard.risk: Looks like every monitoring tool, including the WPF edition.
